profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Software Architect | Microsoft stack since the 1990s, still on the leading edge | C# / .NET 10, Azure, Kubernetes | AI-Assisted Development with Copilot & MCP
profile.summary:
30 years developing for Microsoft tools and frameworks.

I architect and deliver cloud-native backend systems on the Microsoft stack.

At Ivanti I own the ingress path for all data uploaded into the system of record from agents on 100,000+ endpoints across hundreds of enterprise customers, along with the microservices, APIs, and messaging behind it running on Kubernetes and Azure.

I also built the test and release-quality infrastructure as sole contributor: roughly 8,000 unit tests with contract testing and code coverage gates wired into the delivery pipeline, holding a 100% pass rate across the unit libraries. That work moved us from releases that carried unacceptable risk to a daily cadence.

What I work with day to day:
  C# and .NET, every release through .NET 10
  Azure: AKS, Service Bus, Storage, Functions, Application Insights
  Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Istio, Terraform
  SQL Server, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ
  Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, Black Duck
  GitHub Copilot, Model Context Protocol (MCP)

I have been on the Microsoft platform from the start, using Visual Studio from its earliest releases through Visual Studio 2026.

Began at Motorola, where I worked with the operating system design team on the first Windows NT builds for the PowerPC architecture and led internal dogfooding of the only Apple system ever developed outside Apple. I was hired into engineering there before completing my degree, after progressing from operations through Unix systems work and an engineering internship.

Before Ivanti I spent seven years architecting the enterprise platform for a parking and self-storage operator running facilities across New York and New Jersey: a layered Domain-Driven Design backend exposing 1,000+ API methods, grown from CRM into full ERP scope, with a ClickOnce Windows Forms client I authored nearly all of.

Currently focused on agentic development in .NET, C# applications with AI models orchestrated MCP services.

  BSE in Systems Engineering, Arizona State University.
  MBA in Technology Management, University of Phoenix.
  U.S. Marine Corps, Army, and Air Force veteran.

Current Passion Projects
   https://github.com/StewartScottRogers/Curl/
   https://github.com/StewartScottRogers/Surl/

United States citizen. No visa sponsorship needed. Open to direct hire, W-2, or 1099 engagements through U.S.-based staffing firms only; not available through offshore or foreign recruiting vendors.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, R&D
positions.description:
I owned the deployment of scalable backend services and cloud-native systems. My work focuses on building robust microservices and APIs using C# and .NET (5.0–10.0) in Visual Studio 2026, with an emphasis on service reliability, performance, and modern DevOps practices using Claude Code and VS Copilot.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs, HTTP services, and event-driven message listeners for enterprise applications using the latest .NET frameworks inside Docker Containers.
I own the ingress path for all data uploaded into the system of record from agents on 100,000+ endpoints across hundreds of enterprise customers.  - Architect and deliver the cloud-native backend services, microservices, and RESTful APIs behind that pipeline in C# and .NET 5-10 using Visual Studio 2026, owning service reliability and performance. - Design event-driven message listeners and HTTP services deployed as Docker containers on Kubernetes with the Istio service mesh, managed via Helm and Azure Pipelines over Azure Storage, Service Bus, and Application Insights. - Operate the secure CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps, raising release cadence to daily by removing the test risk that had previously made frequent releases unsafe. - Own the test and release-quality infrastructure as sole contributor: roughly 8,000 unit tests with contract testing and code coverage gates, holding a 100% pass rate and full coverage across the unit libraries. - Integrate MongoDB for high-availability document storage and Apache Kafka for distributed messaging, and run application security analysis with Black Duck.  Technologies: .NET 5-10, C#, Visual Studio 2026, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, AKS, Helm, Minikube, Lens, Istio, Azure Service Bus, Azure Storage, Terraform, GitHub Enterprise, MongoDB, Kafka
positions.insights: Skills: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · C# · API Testing · Http Services · REST APIs · Azure Storage · Message Listeners · Azure Service Bus · Helm Charts · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer on Architectural Team (On Contract)
positions.description: - Led research and development of next-generation frameworks and practices on the .NET 5.0 toolset, covering Entity Framework models, GraphQL APIs, and RESTful APIs with OpenAPI integration. - Built shared infrastructure components including MassTransit/RabbitMQ consumers and Hangfire background workers, enabling reuse across multiple project teams. - Standardized SonarQube adoption to enforce code quality, surface technical debt, and keep codebases maintainable across the development life cycle.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer (On Contract)
positions.description: - Developed RESTful APIs on ASP.NET Core 2.2, 3.1, and .NET 5.0, documented with OpenAPI and backed by SQL Server. - Built and maintained Azure Repos and Azure DevOps Pipelines supporting an Azure Service Bus messaging layer that coordinated interactions across 20+ microservices. - Enforced code quality with SonarQube and SonarLint in Visual Studio 2019.

positions.title: .Net DevSecOps Architect/Engineer
positions.description: - Engineered a custom X.509 key signing authority enabling client certificate authentication across a secure microservice infrastructure, eliminating username and password authentication entirely. - Built a TFS build server using FAKE and F#, and integrated Octopus Deploy for CI/CD, automating deployment of 13 distinct resources including IIS applications and microservices via embedded Chocolatey packages and PowerShell. - Developed C# microservices with NancyFX and TopShelf, XSD-defined REST and JSON APIs, a custom SMTP protocol connector, and FIPS 140-2 compliant AES encryption. - Delivered Azure deployments orchestrated through Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Blob Storage, and Queues, plus a reusable Azure Service Fabric actor-based library. - Integrated the platform with leading Gartner Magic Quadrant Enterprise Information Archiving vendors including Smarsh, Global Relay, Actiance, Micro Focus, and Proofpoint. - Ran application security workflows using Veracode static analysis tooling.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Http Services · REST APIs · Azure Storage · Visual Studio

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: - Delivered a secure consumer identity product across the full stack: .NET services, SOAP and web services, ASP.NET Web Forms, WinForms, and Windows Services. - Drove test-driven development with SpecFlow and Gherkin, and UI automation with Selenium WebDriver. - Worked within a Bamboo CI, Crucible peer-review, HP Fortify static analysis, Subversion, and Confluence toolchain. - Authored and open-sourced ApplicationSecureString, a .NET library remediating memory-scraping vulnerabilities against sensitive in-process data.   https://github.com/S-Rogers-Consulting-LLC/ApplicationSecureString
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · REST APIs · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Architect (Consultant)
positions.description: Led seven years of development on the enterprise platform for a parking and self-storage operator running facilities across New York and New Jersey, delivered first as a CRM system and then extended into full ERP scope.  - Architected the layered Domain-Driven Design backend service exposing 1,000+ API methods, and personally authored nearly all of the ClickOnce-deployed Windows Forms client consuming it over .NET Remoting. - Abstracted AS/400 connectivity behind a custom data access layer, with DLINQ and stored procedures for data access. - Applied Gang of Four patterns and Inversion of Control, and authored custom generic patterns including String<T>, Decimal<T>, and Future<T>. - Embedded unit testing throughout the domain and service layers, and ran Agile and Scrum delivery with continuous integration on Team Foundation Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Extensive experience with Visual Studio 2005, including development of Windows Forms, Windows Services, .NET Remoting, and Socket Programming. Proficient with Team Foundation Server for source control, and foundational ASP.NET skills including SOAP services, ASPX pages, and JavaScript/DHTML/HTTP/XML technologies. Skilled in C# 2.0, C++, and Transact-SQL, with hands-on expertise in Active Directory programming (e.g., account creation and management), IIS and SQL Server configuration using automation, and authoring Installation and Setup Programs (WebSetup, Setup Projects, Merge Modules, Custom Actions).

Demonstrates advanced networking knowledge, including router and switch fundamentals (e.g., Switched Packet theory), and deep low-level protocol work such as serializing/deserializing binary packets (e.g., Cisco’s HCAP Protocol). Strong systems administration background, including domain controller setup, IIS and certificate server management, and building out Windows-based enterprise network environments from the ground up.

positions.description: Software Architect at NameScape, a startup company developing its flagship product, Active Catalog. Responsible for ongoing product development, leading architectural enhancements, and implementing both the data abstraction and presentation layers. The application provided White Pages directory services backed by Microsoft Active Directory, ADAM, and LDAP. positions.title: IT CONSULTANT
positions.description:
Healthcare Data Integration Project – Maricopa County
Consulted with Maricopa County to architect and implement eight healthcare provider data feeds. These feeds utilized various transport protocols including FTP, HTTP(S), and SMB, with integrated encryption and compression mechanisms. Development was performed using C# and VBScript.

Healthcare enrollment data was extracted from SQL Server 2000 using stored procedures and Data Transformation Services (DTS). The output was formatted to vendor-specific requirements as either fixed-width ASCII or CSV files.

Additionally, the existing ASP-based open enrollment web application and supporting database were extended to accommodate new project requirements.

positions.title: LEAD INTERNET ARCHITECT -- StockVal
positions.description:
Developed the StockVal Stock Analytics Web Application

1.	Consulted on the architecture of a server farm and its supporting network infrastructure to support high-availability web applications.
2.	Designed and implemented a browser-based thin-client solution using DHTML for IE5.0+, employing JavaScript, VBScript, XML, XSLT, CSS, and ASP for interactive financial data analysis.
3.	Architected the SQL Server backend using normalized Tables, Views, and complex Stored Procedures to support account management, auditing, reporting, and bulk email functionality.
4.	Developed a secondary IE5.5+ DHTML thin client administration portal for internal management tasks.
5.	Integrated a Client-Server ISAPI OCX component to deliver real-time stock analytics to the investment community.
6.	Independently developed and delivered a DHTML and JavaScript solution functionally comparable to Isomorphic's commercial SmartClient product (smartclient.com).

positions.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
positions.description:
Implemented thread safe run time error reporting COM object using Delphi in support of project requirements.  Designed and implemented software deliverables in a team environment.  Developed front-end account management and authentication modules using DHTML, CSS, JavaScript, VBScript, VB Web Classes, Delphi COM objects, PL/SQL and ORACLE Database.

Implemented data migration between various database systems such as Oracle, SAP, Interbase, Flat-files and SQL server using Visual Basic 5.0 & 6.0, ADO, DAO, RDO and Application specific proprietary APIs.  Distributed additions and modifications to 2000+ distributed clients.  
Designed and implemented Stored Procedures, Views, Cursor and Bulk Copy Scripts using SQL Server 6.0.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented 20 Clustered SMP NT IIS Web Servers, 3 Cisco Local Directors and 7 LAN segments in support of Motorola Semiconductor Product Sectors e-commerce initiatives. Administered NT Database connectivity to Sun e4000 UNIX database servers running ORACLE 4.3. Developed Dynamic Page Content with SMART’s integrated Development Environment. 
Designed and implemented DCOM, ASP, VBScript based monitoring tools in support of the conflict resolution centers business requirements. Planned and consulted with multi department teams to meet corporate SOPs, and security requirements. Designed the Motorola Semiconductor Product Sectors Windows NT master domain with 30+ domain controllers serving a 10,000-user community.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founder / Technical Lead – Startup Venture
Successfully led a startup from investment through incorporation. Architected and implemented a full-stack, Windows NT-based e-commerce platform integrating web-based credit card processing into the core application.
1.	Technology Stack: Visual Basic 6.0, COM, ASP, DHTML (IE & Netscape), Windows NT
2.	Designed and developed a COM-based Directory Service for account management.
3.	Built a multi-threaded SMTP bulk emailer for scalable marketing communication.
4.	Created a client-side DHTML printing engine for precision rendering of bank drafts, supporting regulatory compliance in online sales.
5.	Administered the network infrastructure, supporting both customer-facing services and internal operations.
6.	Conceived, designed, and implemented CheckFaxx, a specialized bank draft database and print engine tailored for small-scale telemarketing operations.

positions.title: SYSTEMS ENGINEER
positions.description:
Operating System Development and Platform Integration
Collaborated with the Operating System Design Team at Motorola to roll out the first builds of the Windows NT 3.5 operating system on the PowerPC architecture. Led the "dogfooding" implementation of the only Apple System ever developed outside of Apple, also on PowerPC hardware. Provided platform-level support for multiple Unix variants, contributing to cross-platform OS integration and validation efforts.
